blocks.text: NYON, Switzerland — UEFA is investigating possible misconduct by Ireland and Israel around their bad-tempered Nations League match on Sunday. UEFA announced on Tuesday it appointed an ethics and disciplinary inspector after “the official reports which contained an allegation of an incident in or around the tunnel at halftime.” The European football governing body didn’t immediately offer more details.
